notes.title: Lawyer Guy 'Clockwork Gadget' Hotfix
notes.notes:
The Windows build has been updated:

The Clickteam Fusion runtime has been rolled back to R284.10.
Runtime compression is now disabled.

This seems to have fixed both the antivirus false positives, and the steam overlay glitches, though the overlay has been disabled anyway. The downside is that the old runtime will be a bit slower, maybe about 25%. Let me know if you encounter any performance hiccups.
